title: Restriction of small-etale module direct image to Zariski opens
statement: For any scheme morphism a:U→T and Zariski-etale module contexts cU,cT [def-sfb-scheme-zariski-etale-module-constructions], the canonical small-etale module direct image [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors] has a left adjoint. There is a natural isomorphism a_et,* followed by cT.restriction ≅ cU.restriction followed by a_*. On each module G and open W its component is G applied contravariantly to gabberPreimageEtaleIso(a,W). No quasi-coherence or compactness is assumed.

proof.text: Apply the ringed module adjunction to the scheme base-change morphism of small etale sites. Use the affine etale basis to keep sheafification and module pullback in the section universe u. This supplies the right-adjoint proof hp.

For each open W the canonical scheme pullback is isomorphic to the inverse-image open. Apply G contravariantly to gabberPreimageEtaleIso. Pullback of regular functions identifies the two scalar actions. The universal property of scheme pullback makes this natural in W, and morphism naturality makes it natural in G. Applying G to the inverse isomorphism verifies both inverse identities. These maps assemble the required natural isomorphism.

theorem zariskiEtale_rightAdjoint_square {U T : Scheme.{u}} (a : U ⟶ T)
    (cU : ZariskiEtaleModuleContext U) (cT : ZariskiEtaleModuleContext T) :
    ∃ (hp : (smallEtaleModulePushforward a).IsRightAdjoint)
      (r : smallEtaleModulePushforward a ⋙ cT.restriction ≅
        cU.restriction ⋙ pushforward a),
      ∀ (G : SmallEtaleModules U) (W : T.Opens),
        (r.hom.app G).app W =
          G.val.presheaf.map (AlgebraicGeometry.gabberPreimageEtaleIso a W).hom.op
